policy: Use Gameforge 5.0+ as the content target. Later features require version-specific publisher or selected-client evidence; do not combine conflicting balance rules across patches.
protocol_policy: Keep the working native/login/map handshake consistent. Its numeric version is not a Gameforge marketing patch identifier or proof of official-client compatibility.
official_pvp_modes: Part of the 5.x feature audit; custom boosted starts and private-server rate changes are not the reference.
older_patch_notes: Historical comparisons only; superseded rules do not define the 5.x baseline.
completion_policy: Complete and verify the official game foundations before custom gameplay changes. Require implementation, database persistence, real-client player journeys and reference evidence; passing unit tests alone is insufficient. Do not claim zero defects or full Gameforge parity while required verification or reference data is missing.
